answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day buys 5 exclusive drone-minutes mapping a plume near falcon nests; a cipher hides nest coordinates. Validators check fleet-signed ID/day/drone logs for duration, payment and nonoverlap per drone; failure denies listing. Ten IDs need 10 x 5 = 50 drone-minutes: shared fleets and parallel flights cannot reuse slots. Fees recur; drones are reusable capital; no stake. Fleet honesty is essential: signatures cannot prove flight, so collusion defeats the gate. Spare capacity lowers fees; this meters service, not owners.
